title: Water-Line Hook-Up Charges Outside Contracted Installation, Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
Bridgewell's contracted like-unit cost covers the equipment plus standard installation. For a replacement Bridgewell authorizes on a Homeowner Service Contract after a stalled repair, a water-line connection charge pays for the water hook-ups that this contracted cost leaves out:

- **Refrigerator — 65.00.** Its ice-maker and dispenser supply line is an add-on hook-up beyond standard installation.
- **Dishwasher or clothes washer — 40.00.** Their supply and drain hoses are replaced with the unit.
- **Water heater or any other item — nothing.** Their connections are part of the contracted installation.

The charge is added to the stalled-repair replacement cost as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the cost so obtained is compared with the two remaining benefits (item and aggregate) without being rounded first.

### Item lookup

| Item replaced | Water-line connection charge |
|---|---|
| refrigerator | 65.00 |
| dishwasher | 40.00 |
| clothes washer | 40.00 |
| water heater | none |
| clothes dryer, oven range and cooktop, heating system, and every other item | none |

*Hypothetical:* a stalled-repair replacement cost of 1,180.50 for a dishwasher becomes 1,220.50 once the 40.00 charge is added; that unrounded figure is what is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.
